title: 心理学基礎実験実習Ⅱ
subtitle: Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments II
educationalGoal: Students will learn how to conduct experimental research in psychology, mainly through conducting experiments related to the basic experimental psychology. Students will further develop their knowledge and skills in conducting experiments, analyzing experimental data, and writing experimental reports, based on what they have learned in Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments I.
advice: In this course, the class is divided into two groups, and each group works on two experiments in the first and second half of the class. Students are required to conduct the experiments during the class time and write an experimental report using the data obtained, so if you are absent or even late, it will be difficult to continue the course.
requiredKnowledge: This course is not open to students other than those in the Department of Psychological Science because it involves laboratory exercises.

activityGoals.body: Understand the concept of experiments in psychology.
Able to conduct psychological experiments appropriately.
Able to conduct appropriate statistical analysis according to the experimental design.
Able to write experimental reports appropriate for psychology field.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students will be able to conduct psychological experiments correctly, analyze data appropriately, and summarize the results in a report. In addition, students will be able to correctly understand the purpose and design of the experiment and make logical discussion based on the data.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to conduct psychological experiments correctly, analyze measurement data appropriately, and summarize them in reports.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
